name: Jack Herer
summary: Jack Herer is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] launched by [[breeder:Sensi Seeds]] in 1994, named for the cannabis activist Jack Herer. Leafly describes it as a [[haze|Haze]] hybrid crossed with [[northern-lights-5|Northern Lights #5]] and [[shiva-skunk|Shiva Skunk]]; SeedFinder instead gives a three-way of [[skunk-1|Skunk #1]], Northern Lights #5, and Haze, with no Shiva Skunk. It won first place at the 1994 High Times Cannabis Cup.
